mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, emp_num AS empNum, pwd AS pwd, name AS name, is_active AS isActive, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM "users" WHERE emp_num = #{empNum} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_active = 1
SELECT authority FROM "authorities" WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
